auth.instanceAdminOnly: Only the CMS instance admin can do this
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — wait a few minutes and try again

proxy.tokenOwnerNoAccess: Access token not allowed: its owner has no access to that site
proxy.editSessionScope: Inline-edit session is scoped to GET/PATCH on its own site

mobile.editSessionNotMobile: Inline-edit session is not a mobile login

agents.budgetDay: Agent "{name}" has reached its daily budget (${spent} of ${cap} cap). Increase the cap on the agent's settings page or wait for the period to reset.
agents.budgetWeek: Agent "{name}" has reached its weekly budget (${spent} of ${cap} cap). Increase the cap on the agent's settings page or wait for the period to reset.
agents.budgetMonth: Agent "{name}" has reached its monthly budget (${spent} of ${cap} cap). Increase the cap on the agent's settings page or wait for the period to reset.
agents.templateLocalOnly: Only local templates can be edited
agents.marketplaceUnreachable: Marketplace unreachable. Try again later or use a local template.

lib.capabilityOff: This feature is not enabled for this site
lib.codeUploadRefused: This file type cannot be uploaded (it would be code on the server).
lib.resendKeyMissing: Resend API key not configured. Go to Settings → Email.
lib.importJsonShape: JSON must be an array of objects or an object with a data/items/documents array
lib.invitationExists: An active invitation already exists for this email
lib.selectInvalidValue: {field}: "{value}" is not a valid value — must be one of {allowed}

domains.wildcard: Wildcards cannot be used as a domain: "{value}"
domains.hasPath: A domain cannot contain a path: "{value}"

linkCheck.dangerous: This address can run code in the browser. It should be removed — it is not a link, it is a script.
linkCheck.schemeless: This address is missing https:// — a browser reads it as a page on this site, not as an address out on the web.
linkCheck.imageNotFound: Image file not found on disk
linkCheck.unverifiedNoAnswer: Not verified — the site did not answer ({cause}). The link may well work.
linkCheck.notFoundAnywhere: Not in the sitemap, not a document, and not a page the site answers on
linkCheck.unverifiedNoAddress: Not verified — the site has no public address in its settings, so there is nothing to ask. The link may well work.

sites.cloneNoRegistry: No registry — single-site mode does not support cloning
sites.cloneFilesystemOnly: Only filesystem-backed sites can be cloned
sites.siteIdInOtherOrg: Site ID "{id}" already exists in another org
sites.sameOrg: Source and target org are the same
